item.title: Missing Person: Yasmin Estrella has been Missing Since Jan. 19, 2024 | My Radio Place
item.description: 3/24 The Prescott Valley Police Department re-released information related to a missing persons case. 20-year-old Yasmin Estrella was last seen at her residence on January 19-th, 2024. If you have information on her whereabouts, contact Prescott Valley Police at 928-772-9267.
